notes: Modified cash basis village; trimmed pages: 1 Statement of Net Position, 2 Statement of Activities, 3 governmental assets/fund balances, 4 governmental receipts/disbursements, 5 proprietary assets, 6 proprietary receipts/disbursements, 7-8 budgetary comparison (primary government), 9-10 General Fund departmental analysis. Governmental from Total Governmental Funds column (General, Special Revenue, Debt Service; Debt Service column has no activity). Other general receipts 62,693 split into the General Fund lines of p9 (56,478) and the Special Revenue Fund column 6,215 (p4). The p4 statement prints Streets 27,670 and Park 200,836, while the Statement of Activities and budget schedule show streets 200,836 and culture/recreation 27,670; recorded as printed on p4 with review. Identity: 441,221 + 369,765 - 428,345 + 161,422 = 544,063. Governmental ending/beginning are fund balances (cash 575,116 less due to fire department 31,053). Business-type (Garbage, Electric, Water, Sewer, Utility Deposit; Total column p6): receipts total computed (operating 714,789 + non-operating 1,991); disbursements total 634,239 = Statement of Activities business-type disbursements (p2) = operating 587,299 + bond principal 40,000 + bond interest 6,940. 771,874 + 716,780 - 634,239 - 161,422 = 692,993. Detail: General Fund from the departmental analysis (p9-10); Special Revenue and proprietary funds from their statement columns (p4, p6); the budgetary comparison schedule (p7-8, broad lines for the whole primary government) is not recorded to avoid double counting. Read pages 1-10 of 10.
